title: Synthetic single-dose IV bolus plasma PK
description: Noise-free synthetic plasma concentrations for a one-compartment IV bolus. Both subjects use CL = 0.20 L/h/kg and V = 1.0 L/kg. The 24 h sample is below the 0.01 ug/mL LLOQ and is stored as BLQ. This is not an animal experiment and not a dosing recommendation.
